meta.name: firebase-data-connect
meta.description: Builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect (aka Firebase Data Connect) backends with PostgreSQL securely. Use when designing schemas with tables and relations, writing authorized queries and mutations, configuring real-time data updates, or generating type-safe SDKs. Use when you need a relational database with Firebase, or when the user mentions SQL Connect or Data Connect.

copy.tagline: 构建数据库后端并部署到云端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在给应用搭建带数据库的云端后端
copy.tagline_en: Build and deploy a database backend to the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a relational database for your Firebase app

howto.what: Claude 会帮助你用 PostgreSQL 搭建 Firebase SQL Connect 后端:设计数据表与关系、编写查询和更新操作、配置实时数据同步,并生成各平台的类型安全 SDK,最后还能部署到云端。
howto.when: 当用户需要设计数据库表与关系、编写查询和变更、配置实时更新等,或提到 SQL Connect / Data Connect 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Firebase SQL Connect 建一个用户和订单的数据库模型。
say.note: Claude 会生成 schema 文件并规划关系。

say.text: 给这个项目生成 TypeScript 的 SDK 代码。
我把本地数据库变更部署到线上 Cloud SQL。
say.note: Claude 会运行部署命令更新后端。

howto.what_en: Claude builds and deploys Firebase SQL Connect backends using PostgreSQL, including schema design, queries/mutations, realtime updates, and type-safe SDK generation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user designs database tables/relations, writes queries and mutations, configures realtime updates, or mentions SQL Connect / Data Connect.

say_en.text: Help me create a database model for users and orders with Firebase SQL Connect.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the schema file and plan relationships.

say_en.text: Generate a TypeScript SDK for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will configure the connector and generate a type-safe SDK.

say_en.text: Deploy my local database changes to Cloud SQL.
say_en.note: Claude will run the deploy command to update the backend.
